name: Large gap-down, hold to close
hypothesis: A 3%+ overnight gap down in a top-50 dollar-volume name is mostly forced selling and thin pre-market liquidity, and part of it is bought back through the day as deeper liquidity arrives. At 3% the recoverable move is several times the 5-6 bps round-trip cost, and the trade is rare. The earlier 1% gap fade had gross -1.1 bps, so this is a bet that only the extreme tail overreacts. Written before any run. Expected to fail if 3% gaps in large caps are almost all news (earnings, guidance), which drifts further down: the stop at 3% then dominates.
